app_store.name: BubbyPDF: PDF Editor
app_store.subtitle: Edit, fill and sign offline
app_store.promotional_text: Every tool is free: fill forms, sign, add text, merge and reorder pages. No account, no trial, nothing to cancel.
app_store.description:
BubbyPDF edits PDFs on your computer, for free.

Open a PDF and fill its form fields, add text, sign it, add check marks, highlight, draw, or cover something with white. Merge files, drag pages into a new order, rotate, delete or pull pages out into a new PDF. Search shows every match in a list.

What is different:
- Every feature is free. There is no paid plan.
- No account and no sign-in.
- Your files never leave your computer.
- No pop-ups, no ads, no AI assistant.
- Save writes a new copy, so your original stays safe. Undo works.

Windows 10 and 11.
